title: Parameter-superposed expert bank with Mirror unbinding

model.expert_id: oracle provided to isolate storage from routing

strata: aligned single-plane Givens orbit around shared base
independent rank-2 expert residuals around shared base

hypothesis: A shared expert tensor plus one per-expert Givens coordinate can preserve aligned expert behavior at lower serialized bytes than independent experts and native PSP; independent expert residuals may require private state.
mirror_coordinate: per-expert one-plane Givens angle plus expert address
logical_multiplicity: 8 expert functions from one physical matrix plus codes
controls: native PA16 random-sign parameter superposition and unbinding

development.allowed: validate deterministic task generation, metric shapes, serialization and coordinate fitting; no architecture selection

storage.authority: actual torch-serialized inference payload bytes, including all experts/factors/codes and metadata

success_gate: Aligned stratum: Mirror NRMSE <=0.01, payload <=50% untied and at least 20% smaller than rank-2 control at <=0.01 NRMSE across each fresh world.
failure_gate: Mirror aligned NRMSE >0.05, no byte improvement over rank-2 at matched quality, or native PSP fails useful recovery.
boundaries: Synthetic linear experts only; no language quality or learned router claim.
Expert IDs are supplied and do not test routing.
Aligned orbit is feasibility; random rank-2 residual stratum maps the private-state frontier.

amendment_before_fresh.reason: Pre-fresh implementation audit found a linear map transpose error and unconstrained angle optimization outside the generator’s known [-0.7,0.7] range. Untied exact-reference test caught the orientation error.
amendment_before_fresh.change: Use forward x@W consistently; fit bounded coordinate a=0.7*tanh(z) for 500 Adam steps at lr 0.03. This encodes the generator bound, with no data-dependent selection.
amendment_before_fresh.superseded_dev: Initial development rows are retained as superseded exploratory outputs; corrected rerun is authoritative.

amendment_A1_timing.reason: Initial fresh output serialized an apply_seconds field as zero without timing the matrix application.
amendment_A1_timing.change: Replay exact same fresh worlds/seeds/task matrices/conditions. Compute predictions as before, then perform 5 warmup and 20 timed per-expert matrix applications; report median elapsed time per application. No quality/storage/model or hyperparameter change.
amendment_A1_timing.authoritative: Original quality metrics and payload hashes must remain identical; only apply_seconds is replaced by repeated median CPU timing.

amendment_A2_serializer_and_decode.reason: Audit of actual payloads found native PSP serialized its deterministic random context tensor explicitly, while rank-2 control stored a Python list of separate factor tensors, inflating both controls with reconstructible state/container overhead. Coordinate decode costs were also not measured.
amendment_A2_serializer_and_decode.change: Store PSP seed+PRNG metadata and reconstruct contexts deterministically; stack rank-2 factors contiguously; measure load-time reconstruction for PSP, Mirror and rank-2 controls. Re-run exact same fresh worlds/seeds/tasks.
amendment_A2_serializer_and_decode.authoritative: Quality values must match prior fresh outputs exactly; serialized bytes and decode_seconds are replaced by canonical packed payload accounting. Prior payloads/results remain preserved under artifacts/payloads_pre_A2 and artifacts/fresh_before_A2_accounting.csv.
